# FREE LEAD MAGNET: 2026 GDPR ARTICLE 28 SUB-PROCESSOR VETTING CHECKLIST

*Part of the 2026 GDPR & CNIL Pro Legal Suite by EroNiiChan.*

Before signing any B2B SaaS agreement, vendor contract, or integrating third-party APIs handling EU user personal data, verify the following 7 statutory requirements:

- [ ] **1. Processing Scope & Documented Instructions (Art. 28(3)(a))**:
  Ensure the contract explicitly states that the processor acts only on written instructions from the controller, including regarding cross-border transfers.

- [ ] **2. Personnel Confidentiality & Statutory Secrecy (Art. 28(3)(b))**:
  Verify written commitment ensuring that persons authorized to process personal data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of secrecy.

- [ ] **3. Security of Processing Safeguards (Art. 32 & Art. 28(3)(c))**:
  Obtain technical confirmation of TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, automated encrypted backups, role-based access control, and regular penetration testing reports.

- [ ] **4. Sub-processor Prior Written Notice (Art. 28(2) & 28(4))**:
  Mandate at least 14 to 30 days prior written notice before onboarding or replacing any sub-contractors, with an explicit right for the controller to object or terminate.

- [ ] **5. Data Breach Notification SLA (Art. 33 & Art. 28(3)(f))**:
  Contractual obligation for the processor to notify the controller within 24 to 36 hours of detecting a confirmed security compromise or data leakage.

- [ ] **6. Post-Termination Erasure & Return Protocol (Art. 28(3)(g))**:
  Mandatory deletion or return of all personal data and existing backup copies within 30 days following contract termination, with written certificate of destruction.

- [ ] **7. Transatlantic Transfer Shield (Chapter V GDPR)**:
  For US-headquartered sub-processors (e.g. AWS, Stripe, Google, OpenAI), verify active self-certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) or execute the 2021/914 Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) with a Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA).
